Bash(cd /d/PerfumeSite/app && ls -la | grep -E "locale|shop|auth" ; echo "---try via powershell-friendly---"; ls -d '[locale]' 2>&1)

PowerShell(Set-Location 'D:\\PerfumeSite\\app'; try { Move-Item -LiteralPath '\(shop\)' -Destination '[locale]\\\(shop\)' -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output 'shop moved' } catch { Write-Output "shop FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; try { Move-Item -LiteralPath '\(auth\)' -Destination '[locale]\\\(auth\)' -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output 'auth moved' } catch { Write-Output "auth FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, StartTime, @{n='cmd';e={\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($_.Id\)"\).CommandLine}} | Format-List; Write-Output '---attrib---'; \(Get-Item -LiteralPath 'D:\\PerfumeSite\\app\\\(shop\)'\).Attributes)

PowerShell(Set-Location 'D:\\PerfumeSite\\app'; try { Rename-Item -LiteralPath '\(auth\)' -NewName '_auth_test' -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output 'sibling rename OK'; Rename-Item -LiteralPath '_auth_test' -NewName '\(auth\)'; Write-Output 'renamed back' } catch { Write-Output "rename FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(Set-Location 'D:\\PerfumeSite\\app'; if \(Test-Path -LiteralPath '[locale]'\) { $items = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '[locale]' -Force -Recurse; if \($items\) { Write-Output "NOT empty: $\($items.Count\) items"; $items | Select-Object FullName } else { Remove-Item -LiteralPath '[locale]' -Force; Write-Output 'removed empty [locale]' } } else { Write-Output 'no [locale]' })
